title: Classicality is Zariski local
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a discrete commutative ring and $F$ a
$\Lambda_X$-module sheaf on $X_{\Proet}$. If $X=\bigcup_aX_a$ is an open covering
such that each restriction $F|_{X_a}$ is classical on $(X_a)_{\Proet}$, then $F$ is
classical. Conversely the restriction of a classical sheaf to an open subscheme
is classical.

proof.text: For the underlying set sheaf G, the essential-image equivalence of [det-pe-classical-sheaves-image] turns classicality of each open restriction into an etale presentation. Sectionwise module restriction followed by the forgetful functor is definitionally the sectionwise set restriction. Replace the arbitrary index type by the subtype range(U) of X.Opens, lifted to the site universe; classicality on each distinct open follows by choosing an original index.

The distinct opens form a pro-etale cover of the final object. More explicitly, over every pro-etale object T use the opens T.hom inverse-image U. Their inclusions are jointly surjective because the original opens have supremum top. The Zariski-cover criterion of [sk-def-pe-site], implemented by Scheme.ProEt.mem_topology_of_openImmersion, makes the sieve of objects mapping into a cover member covering. Restricting T.hom to its inverse-image open gives the required map into that member.

Apply the first clause of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-locally-classical-etale-cover] to the underlying set sheaf and this cover. It gives a global etale presentation. The essential-image equivalence [det-pe-classical-sheaves-image] then proves the required continuity-map classicality. This uses the already stated stronger set-sheaf descent theorem rather than constructing linear transition maps and gluing module models.

For the converse, take an affine etale presentation P over an open U as in [det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map]. Compose its diagram and cone with the localization functor to X. The affine schemes are unchanged and the composite of each etale structure map with the open immersion is etale. Cofiltered categories are connected; the over-category forgetful functor preserves connected limits and reflects limits, so P remains a limit in schemes over X. The section diagram and restriction cocone of the set restriction along U are definitionally those of the composed presentation. Thus its continuity map is bijective by classicality on X.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 5.1.2 and 5.1.4; the blueprint converse is proved directly using composed affine presentations and connected limits in over-categories.
